description: Six public-domain two-speaker scenes for scene_context_listening.py. Line text and speakers are NOT stored here: each turn names a PDNC row id and the harness reads the text from the checked-in gold fixture, so nothing is retyped. The scene descriptions and per-line instructions were written by hand on 2026-10-26, before any audio was rendered, and must not be tuned after listening.

scenes.scene: A drawing room at Longbourn. An excitable wife bursts with gossip about a rich new neighbour while her dry, unhurried husband teases her.

turns.instruct: Dry and teasing, a mock compliment at the end.

scenes.scene: An evening at Netherfield. A proud gentleman and a sharp young woman spar politely across the room, each enjoying the contest.

turns.instruct: Arch and playful, stressing the contrast.
Lively and ironic, building through the list.

scenes.scene: A quiet morning at Hartfield. Two old friends make easy, affectionate conversation while waiting for a visitor who is late.

turns.instruct: Slightly anxious, glancing at the door.

scenes.scene: After an evening party, in front of the family. A frank older friend presses a young woman who is defensive and a little sulky about a rival.

turns.instruct: Pointed and meaningful, holding her eye.
Short and cool, closing the subject.

scenes.scene: A cheerful family visit. A brisk naval wife scolds her brother, a captain, for his old-fashioned gallantry; the argument is fond, not bitter.

turns.instruct: Defensive, a little pleased with himself.
Spirited and firm, making her point.

scenes.scene: A crowded room in Bath. Two former lovers, apart for eight years, speak quietly by the fireplace; every ordinary word carries old feeling.

turns.instruct: Quiet, with a trace of bitterness.
Barely above a whisper, trailing off.
